summary: Fixed Unicode bidirectional override character sanitization to prevent display spoofing attacks
implementation_notes: Added sanitization for Unicode bidirectional/format characters (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069, U+200E-U+200F, U+FEFF) using \uXXXX escape sequences. Normal Unicode (emoji, CJK, accented chars) passes through unchanged.
